parameters.grid_region: Netherlands (assumed from VU Amsterdam lab context)
parameters.grid_factor_basis: 2026 Dutch location-based gridmix: 244 gCO2e/kWh production and fuel chain plus 16 gCO2e/kWh electricity infrastructure; annual reporting factor, not measured October 2026 intensity
parameters.embodied_basis: Whole-workstation proxy: Dell Precision 7960 Tower PCF, March 2023: 2971 kgCO2e times (22.9% manufacturing + 2.5% transport + 0.6% end of life). Not an LCA of glg2 or its actual two GPUs.
parameters.notes: Other hardware, PSU efficiency, PUE, lifespan and exclusive reservation are explicit modeling assumptions. No idle subtraction. Calibration power is estimated from the corresponding evaluation benchmark and fixed-model strategy. Initial setup uses the recorded creation-to-first-process elapsed time less the first cooldown. Unknown later setup, fitting, downloads, tests and analysis time are excluded and disclosed, not treated as measured zero.

functional_units.evaluation: one executed held-out benchmark query, including all router/model calls
functional_units.campaign: one recorded campaign subtotal, R=1; alternatively allocate its carbon over 10000 held-out query executions

limitations: Annual Dutch grid factor and physical Netherlands location assumption.
Additional hardware power, PSU efficiency, cooling and whole-machine LCA proxy are modeled.
Recorded campaign is a subtotal: unlogged model loading, downloads, router fitting, additional warmups/retries, development, analysis and report-writing are unquantified.
Continuous reservation across timestamp gaps is unknown; shown separately.
A 2 ms query tail is unmetered; no extrapolation is added to sampled-window totals.
Five repetitions reuse the same questions; no independent-query or causal claim follows.
